Independent finite exact gcd windows for six primes
correctness.rationale: Cassini gives primitive seeds and norm µ=b²-ab-a²=L_h, and the recurrence companion matrix sends the state to its negative mod L_h after h steps. For odd k the reversible linear and square recurrences, telescoping identities and alternating norm force both window gcds to divide 2L_h. At every odd prime power of L_h, the original state has exact period 2h while its square sequence has exact period h: h primality, invertibility T²-I and q!=3 exclude smaller periods. Mod 2 gives period 3, with one allowed factor 2. Assembly yields the exact formulas, and maximum B=2L_h occurs in a unique residue mod 3h on odd lengths, proving leastness. Checked h=5,7,11,13,17,19 and odd k<=6h by independent integer recurrence.
residual_risks: Signed seeds and positive odd windows only; gcd of finitely many translates is justified by order-two/order-three reversible recurrences.

final_claim: For all prime h>=5 the signed Fibonacci seeds (F_h,-F_(h-1)-1) have odd-window gcds A_h(k)=2^[3|k] and B_h(k)=A_h(k)L_h^[h|k], with least odd-index periods 3 and 3h, hence unbounded period-ratio h.
limitations: Only prime h>=5 and odd positive k
